The '''Shimmering Falls''' was a massive, 200 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall [[Water/Legends|waterfall]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. Behind the Falls were [[Cave/Legends|caves]] that served as a burial ground for [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="OAA1" />
